buy_hold.label: Buy rule that keeps a stock until it reaches its base fair value

skip_expensive.label: Covered basket without stocks priced above their high fair value

tilt.label: Covered basket with Buy stocks at double weight

tilt_quarterly.label: Buy-stock tilt, rebalanced every three months

headline: The Buy rule did not clearly beat or trail the covered stocks weighted by company size: 11.1% a year against 12.8% after trading costs, with a worst fall of -8.2% against -47.7%. The 95% range for the yearly difference is -17.4 points to +10.4 points.
